title: OFDM Demodulator
text: Demodulate time-domain OFDM samples and return subcarriers for custom communication protocols, 8 inputs, 3 outputs, {Rounding Method} sets Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations; {OFDM parameters source} sets the source of OFDM, {Maximum FFT length} sets the maximum length of FFT length, {FFT length} sets the length of FFT, {Cyclic prefix length} sets the length of cyclic prefix, {Number of left guard subcarriers} sets the number of guard band subcarriers in left extreme of OFDM, {Number of right guard subcarriers} sets the number of guard band subcarriers in right extreme of OFDM, {Enable CP fraction} sets the cP fraction enabler, {CP fraction source}, {CP fraction} sets the percent of cyclic prefix to remove, {Remove DC subcarrier} sets the exclude or include DC subcarrier, {Enable reset input port} sets the reset signal and {Divide butterfly outputs by two} sets the divide FFT butterfly outputs by two. Values come from the instance.
